ranked.headline: Computational methods for single-cell annotation, integration and trajectory inference
ranked.summary: Generative and LLM-based models now address confounded latent variation, cross-dataset cell annotation, and pseudotime testing in single-cell omics.

ranked.headline: Network-based models integrate omics layers to infer regulatory structure
ranked.summary: Graph neural networks, factor models, and causal structure learning are now applied to integrate omics layers and infer regulatory networks.

ranked.headline: Multimodal deep learning links molecular graphs, sequences and structures to bioactivity
ranked.summary: Recent November 2025 publications pair pretrained language-model embeddings with graph networks to predict protein, molecule and drug-target properties.

ranked.headline: Attention-based sequence models target RNA, DNA, and protein prediction tasks
ranked.summary: Pretrained and interpretable sequence models now span mRNA foundation models, m6A detection, and transposable element classification.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks and tools extract variants and modifications from error-prone sequencing reads
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers benchmark callers and profilers against reference truth sets using noisy nanopore, short-read, and single-cell data.

ranked.headline: Linking spatial transcriptomic snapshots across time points to infer cell fate dynamics
ranked.summary: Sequential spatial transcriptomics slides across developmental time points enable trajectory inference beyond independent snapshots.

ranked.headline: Reproducible workflows and tools now span NGS, metagenome, amplicon, and virome analysis
ranked.summary: Recent releases pair method-level tools with reproducible pipelines across viral, metagenomic, amplicon, and nanopore sequencing analyses.

ranked.headline: Generative models now target multi-objective design of molecules, peptides and aptamers
ranked.summary: Transformer and variational autoencoder architectures are being benchmarked and tuned for property-controlled design across small molecules and biopolymers.

ranked.headline: Coupling omics, histopathology and cfDNA fragmentation in cancer prediction models
ranked.summary: Multi-omics, pathology images and cfDNA fragmentation are now being fused in learned models for cancer subtyping, mutation inference and early detection.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models predict epigenomic and regulatory states from DNA sequence
ranked.summary: Recent items extend sequence-based models to chromatin structure, personalized diploid genomes, and long-read mosaic variant calling.

ranked.headline: Learned models assign heterogeneous biological measurements to discrete sources
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers apply learned models directly to raw nanopore signals and sequence metadata for assignment tasks.

ranked.headline: Transformers predict disease risk and variant effects from clinical and omics data
ranked.summary: Proteomic, EHR, imaging, and sequence data are now being modeled by transformers and LLMs with explicit biological context and uncertainty estimates.

ranked.headline: Network and deep learning models prioritize existing drugs and predict drug synergy
ranked.summary: Multimodal and network-level features now link disease transcriptomes, gene networks, and drug-target resources to nominate repurposing candidates.

ranked.headline: Statistical R packages for microbiome, methylation and repertoire data analysis
ranked.summary: Recent method papers package statistical workflows for microbiome, methylation, and pathogen data into reusable software with explicit error control.

ranked.headline: Inferring regulatory elements, splicing activity and variant effects across tissues
ranked.summary: Large atlases, MPRA benchmarks and deep models now map regulatory activity per cell, per tissue and per species at scale.

ranked.headline: Post-association methods adapt inference to relatedness and pathway specificity
ranked.summary: Recent work adapts post-GWAS inference to related samples, genomic prediction models and pathway specificity rather than new association discovery.

ranked.headline: Structure-aware methods predict complex binding, conformations and mutation energetics
ranked.summary: Independent benchmarks now test AlphaFold3 and ΔΔG predictors alongside new structure-aware architectures for molecular complexes.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools make single-cell, spatial, and metabolic analyses reproducible
ranked.summary: Recent published and preprint work packages computational biology methods as containerized, web-based, and open-source software for direct use.

ranked.headline: Learned representations map spatial tissue structure from expression and histology
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair graph encoders and histology guidance with contrastive objectives to recover spatial domains, expression patterns, and…

ranked.headline: Protein language models infer disorder, phase separation, and lipid binding
ranked.summary: Six November 2025 publications apply protein language model embeddings to annotation gaps in kinases, lipid binding, and phase separation.

ranked.headline: LLMs extract bioinformatics workflows and structure biomedical knowledge for reuse
ranked.summary: LLM-based extraction from publications and clinical reports is producing structured, machine-usable resources for bioinformatics workflows.

ranked.headline: Protein language model embeddings power sequence-based prediction and structural tasks
ranked.summary: Pretrained PLM embeddings now feed residue-level, interaction, allergenicity, and homology-search pipelines, with structural adapters extending them.

ranked.headline: Learned models extend structure prediction to crystal imaging and genome annotation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published tool apply deep learning to structure prediction, crystal detection, variant effects, and genome annotation.

ranked.headline: Temperature reshapes non-CG methylation diversity in Arabidopsis via RdDM-CMT2 balance
ranked.summary: Long-read and population-scale methylome profiling now resolves epigenomic variation across temperature, telomeres, and organelle genomes.

ranked.headline: Software and ML frameworks automate molecular dynamics setup and kinetics prediction
ranked.summary: November 2025 preprints and papers pair machine-learned potentials and kinetics prediction with tools for preparing MD-ready structures.

ranked.headline: Diffusion and language models extend de novo design of antibodies and TCRs
ranked.summary: RFdiffusion now yields de novo antibodies binding user-specified epitopes, while new models target CDR-H3 and TCR CDR3 generation.

ranked.headline: Equivariant diffusion models generate protein conformational ensembles and trajectories
ranked.summary: Preprints and papers benchmark ensemble-generating folding models and SE(3)-parameterized diffusion for protein conformational dynamics.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-level assemblies of annelid, cricket and truffle genomes
ranked.summary: Combined long-read, short-read and Hi-C data yield chromosome-level assemblies paired with annotation and public functional resources.

ranked.headline: Mobile genetic elements and gene variation profiled across bacterial and phage genomes
ranked.summary: Population-scale genome collections now enable systematic enumeration of mobile elements, phage tail proteins, and gene-level variation with host linkage.

ranked.headline: Open tools integrate holo-omics data and upstream proteomics and single-cell QC
ranked.summary: Recent releases package integration and preprocessing steps as openly available, reusable tools for reproducible multi-omics workflows.

ranked.headline: Faster, leaner tools for alignment, motif scoring, genome sizing and read partitioning
ranked.summary: Recent tools report large memory and runtime gains, including a 1000-fold motif-scoring speedup and 89M reads processed in under a minute.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale models and enzyme mining resolve microbial metabolic capabilities
ranked.summary: Large-scale genome and enzyme mining now links microbial metabolic capacity to strain identity and food ecosystems.

ranked.headline: Quantifying per-gene predictability of expression from H&E histology images
ranked.summary: A new mutual-information score measures per-gene predictability from H&E images, alongside tumor-recurrence and gene-network methods.

ranked.headline: Network-based multi-omics integration and targeted lipid and cytokine profiling
ranked.summary: Open-source tools for network-based multi-omics integration and lipidomics and cytokine array analysis appeared in late 2025 preprints and publications.

ranked.headline: Simulations link resistance mechanisms to treatment outcomes and colonization
ranked.summary: Computational models now quantify how plasmid-borne resistance, dosing schedules, and resource supply shape infection and microbial invasion outcomes.

ranked.headline: Deep generative and graph models for single-cell and spatial gene expression
ranked.summary: Latent diffusion and graph contrastive models now target generation and joint embedding of single-cell and multi-slice spatial transcriptomics.

ranked.headline: Tools mining literature and networks to interpret gene regulation and drug effects
ranked.summary: Public transcriptomic data, PubMed abstracts and gene regulatory networks are now mined computationally at scale for functional interpretation.

ranked.headline: Computational models now encode modification chemistry for peptide and PTM assignment
ranked.summary: Prediction and spectral assignment of modified peptides are being extended to explicit modification chemistry and coexisting PTM states.

ranked.headline: Causal brain networks, subtype metabolism, and corpus callosum genetics in disease
ranked.summary: Systems-level models now link causal network influences, neuronal metabolic states, and callosal genetics to neurodegenerative and neuropsychiatric disease.

ranked.headline: Statistical frameworks for higher-order epistasis, heterosis, and genomic prediction
ranked.summary: Higher-order epistasis, heterosis, and marker-based prediction each demand statistical models that go beyond single-locus scans.
